sentences.text:
on 11 June, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.10344 Of 2021
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to o issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or Orders or Direction or Directions to declare the inaction of the respondents Nos.4 and 5 in not disposing the applications/representations dated 30.05.2017, 02.08.2017,
13.10.2017, 23.10.2017, 26.11.2018 and 15.06.2020 in granting the exgracia/compensation to petitioners even after acquisition of the land of the petitioners by the respondents without any valid land acquisition proceedings as well as without issuing any notices under Land Acquisition Proceedings to the petitioners

is illegal, arbitrary, against to the natural justice in acquiring the property of the petitioners situated in Sy.No.111, TS LR No.1, Block-A, Ward No.203, Talab Chanchalam, Charminar Mandal in laying the Pillar No.1, 2 and 7 under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by not determining the amount of compensation contrary to the provisions of the new Act of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by passing any Award without taking the objections of the petitioner is illegal, unconstitutional and unsustainable and to issue a consequential direction to the respondent No.5 to pass an Award afresh under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by determining the compensation amount under Section 24 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and to pass..."
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Municipal SK,J Administration and Urban Development, learned Standing Counsel for GHMC, learned counsel for Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel appearing for the respondents submits that the respondents will consider the representations filed by the petitioners on 30.05.2017, 02.08.2017, 13.10.2017, 23.10.2017,
26.11.2018 and 15.06.2020 in due course and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

4. In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondent Nos.3 to 5 to dispose of the representations filed by the petitioners on 30.05.2017, 02.08.2017, 13.10.2017, 23.10.2017, SK,J 26.11.2018 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law within eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy Mohammed Osman Qureshi And Another vs State Of Telangana Amd 5 Others on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15296438/
1 of this order.
